extension.description: Visual control panel for plugins, skills, and rules in Antigravity IDE. Toggle customizations in 1 click without digging through .gemini
viewsContainers.activitybar.title: 🧩 Plugins
views.plugin-manager.name: Plugin Manager
config.storagePath.description: Custom absolute path for global plugins storage directory
config.language.description: Interface language (auto: default system language, or choose manual)
config.editorOpenColumn.description: Where to open resource files: in a tab alongside the manager (active) or in a split side pane (beside)
config.statusBar.showSkills.description: Display active and total skill counts in the status bar
config.statusBar.showRules.description: Display active and total rule counts in the status bar
config.statusBar.format.description: Status bar display format: icons only ($(extensions) 1/7 | 📖 12/57 | 📜 3/5), full text (Plugins: 1/7 | Skills: 12/57 | Rules: 3/5), or compact numbers (1/7 | 12/57 | 3/5)
config.statusBar.iconSet.description: Icon set used in the status bar: extensions icon $(extensions) + open book 📖, bookmark tabs 📑, notebook 📓, native VS Code codicons, plug 🔌, or puzzle 🧩
config.updates.autoCheck.description: How often to automatically check for plugin updates from GitHub (startup, hourly, daily, weekly, or never)
